info.title: PokeAPI Core Universal API
info.description: Access the public PokeAPI v2 catalog of Pokemon, species, abilities, types, moves, items, berries, evolution chains, generations, Pokedexes, regions, and locations.

get.description: Retrieves an ability from PokeAPI Core.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: idOrName
parameters.description: Ability numeric ID or exact PokeAPI ability name.

schema.description: Ability numeric ID or exact PokeAPI ability name.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

is_main_series.description: Whether the ability is part of the main series games.

pokemon.description: Pokemon that can have this ability.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves a page of abilities from PokeAPI Core.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

count.description: Total number of ability resources available.

next.description: URL for the next page of results, when available.

previous.description: URL for the previous page of results, when available.

results.description: Ability resource references for the current page.
